appName.description: Name of the MuleSoft application as it appears in Anypoint Runtime Manager.

environment.description: Anypoint environment where the app runs (e.g. Production, Staging, Development).

jiraTicketId.description: Optional Jira ticket ID to link the assessment to a migration ticket.

repo.description: GitHub repository override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

headSha.description: Repo HEAD at assess time (stale-plan anchor).

owner.description: GitHub owner/org override (used only when the app is not in the registry).

appPath.description: Path to the Mule module within the repo (e.g. "." for repo root).

orgId.description: Anypoint organization ID override (registry/convention fallback otherwise).

branch.description: Explicit branch. Highest precedence over registry default / discovered default.

deployedApiName.description: Exact deployed application name in Anypoint Runtime Manager to look up (matched VERBATIM in the given environment). When found, the running runtime/Java/status/replicas/last-deploy are reported on deployedStateCheck; when omitted, not configured, or not found, the check is skipped with a stated reason. ARM does not expose deployed connector versions, so this informs the runtime/Java picture only. Non-fatal.

includeVersions.description: Opt in to the rich connector version MENU (connectorChoices[]: options, firstCompatible, latestInMajor, latest, staleness). Default false — assess is LEAN and the ChangePlan's connectorsInApp[] already shows each app connector's current vs matrix pin. For the full menu prefer the resolve_versions tool. Adds live Exchange + release-notes fetches (slower).

includeDrift.description: Opt in to the gating matrix-drift advisory (matrixDrift: runtime patch, mule-maven-plugin, MUnit plugins vs live Maven metadata). Default false. For the standalone drift audit prefer the check_drift tool. Adds live metadata fetches (slower).
